about_desc: How your family sees you, and how FamilyWell looks for you. You can change all of it later in Settings.
about_sub: A name for your family to see, your language, and the colours you like.
no_card_title: One price. You pick it at the end.
no_card_body: Set things up and take the short tour first. The plan comes last, once you've seen your home working, and it's one price for everyone.
welcome_sub: Let's set up your family's space. It takes about two minutes, and everything can be changed later.
plan_later: Not yet, let me look around first
plan_install: Add it to your Home Screen
join_body: Open the link in the invitation email on this device. It brings you straight into that family, no setup needed. Can't find it? Ask them to send it again.
family_title: What should we call your family?
family_sub: This is what everyone sees when they open FamilyWell.
family_hint: You can rename it anytime in Settings.
color_symbol: Pick a color and a symbol
symbol_none: Nothing by that name. Try another word.
region_sub: From where you're signing up · change anytime
region_desc: The currency your shared costs start in and how distances show. Both can be changed later in Settings.
invite_sub: They'll get a short email and join with one tap. FamilyWell is better with everyone in it.
invite_bad_email: That doesn't look like an email address.
invite_one_price: Everyone's included. One price per family, not per person.
role_adult_desc: Sees and edits everything, runs the family
role_teen_desc: Sees and edits everything, can't manage people
modules_sub: Start small, it's how habits stick. Every module is included, so turn on the rest whenever you like.
modules_more: + Contacts and more in Settings → Modules
modules_pick_one: Pick at least one to go on.
modules_request_desc: Ask for it, or vote on others
install_title: Put FamilyWell on your Home Screen.
install_sub: This step is required. It opens full screen like any app, and on iPhone it's the only way reminders can reach you.
ios_1_sub: The square with the arrow, down in Safari's bar.
ios_2_sub: Scroll the menu a little if you don't see it.
install_3: 3. Open it from your Home Screen
install_3_sub: We'll pick up right where you left off.
install_waiting: Waiting for you to open it from your Home Screen
install_escape: Can't add it here? Continue in the browser
handoff_title: Now take it to your phone.
handoff_sub: That's where the grocery list gets checked and reminders actually land. Scan the code, you'll be signed in already.
handoff_2: Add FamilyWell to your Home Screen
handoff_email_q: No camera handy? We'll email you a sign-in link.
handoff_computer: No phone? Install it on this computer instead
computer_prompt: Install FamilyWell as an app on this computer: its own window and icon, and reminders even when the browser is closed.
computer_manual: In Safari, choose File → Add to Dock. In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon at the right of the address bar. Then carry on.
one_price_title: One price for the whole family.
one_price_body: Bring everyone, turn on every module. You'll pick monthly or yearly at the end, once FamilyWell already feels like home.
one_price_rail: Everyone you invite is included. Pick a plan at the end, after the tour.
welcome_sub_wide: Let's set up your family's space. Four quick steps, a short tour, and everything can be changed later.
preview_caption: Updates as you type. Colour and symbol show up on everyone's phone.
symbol_hint: Can't find yours? Search by word: dog, guitar, beach.
invite_included_body: One price per family, not per person. Grandparents, teens, the nanny: add as many as you like.
ios_1_sub_ipad: The square with the arrow, top right in Safari's bar.
module_tasks_desc_long: Due dates and who's on it
module_recipes_desc_long: Scale any recipe to what you have
module_birthdays_desc_long: Ages, and the next one coming
notify_title: Never miss what matters at home.
notify_sub: Choose what FamilyWell can tell you about. Quiet by default, never marketing.
notify_ask_iphone: Your iPhone will ask next. Tap “Allow”.
notify_ask_ipad: Your iPad will ask next. Tap “Allow”.
notify_ask_browser: Your browser will ask next. Click “Allow”.
notify_panel: How they'll look on this computer
notify_example_shopping: :a added oat milk and eggs to Groceries.
notify_example_tasks: “Pay daycare” is due today. :a assigned it to you.
notify_example_spending: :a paid for the groceries. Your share is ready to settle.
notify_example_inventory: Oat milk is running low. Add it to Shopping?
notify_example_vehicles: The car's oil change is due next week.
ready_invites_sub: They'll join with one tap from the email
ready_plan_title: Last stop after the tour: your plan.
ready_plan_body: Pick monthly or yearly and you're done. One price for the whole family, every module included.
tour_1_body: Tap one to open it. Want Recipes or Vehicles too? Add them anytime from Modules, they're all included.
tour_2_body: Snap a receipt, type “milk, eggs, bread” or “dentist Thursday 4pm”. FamilyWell sorts it into the right place for you.
plan_sub: One plan for the whole family: every module, as many people as you like.
plan_intro: Intro price for the first :total families · :left left
plan_inc_open: Your fee funds the open project
plan_inc_ads: No ads, ever. Your data isn't sold
plan_methods: Apple Pay, Google Pay or card, on Stripe's secure page.
plan_payer: You're paying for :name. :names never get a bill.
plan_payer_solo: You're paying for :name, one price for everyone you add.
plan_canceled: No payment was taken. Pick a plan whenever you're ready.
plan_selfhost: Rather run it yourself? It's open source.
